summary:
Lane systems passes round 1. Both major items, done:5 and gameplay:G3, are met. I re-ran both full soaks myself at HEAD, and both exit 0 with every enforced gate passing.
- Veteran vs novice: 39/40 (seeds 1-20) and 38/40 (seeds 21-40). The bar is 34/40.
- Veteran vs adept: 34/40 and 32/40. The bar is 26/40.
- Holdout seeds 41-80, which the lane never tuned on: 73/80 vs novice and 65/80 vs adept.
The novice change touches only perception and execution knobs (difficulty.ts). The thinkAnswers additions read only visible enemy Wicks (perception.ts:110-115).
FRAY G6 and G9 now pass with a margin:
- Lull gate: 96/94 % on seeds 1-100 and 94/94 % on seeds 21-120.
- On unseen seeds 601-800: 95.0 / 93.5 %, and the worst 100-seed window is 91 % at both tiers.
- Placements: 4.14-6.82, 4.19-6.73 and 4.18-6.76 on those three seed sets.
Other checks:
- typecheck exit 0.
- content:check OK. Its one warning is the map_fray 'centre', which is the world lane's file and is handed off.
- Lane probes: 42/42 PASS, including determinism, rekey, practice, fray 34/34 and draft_pace 28/28.
- RIFT, BRIDGE and mirror results are byte-identical to the engineers' full1 / full21 runs.
One minor item fails: systems-18. Its evidence is wrong. On seeds 1-20, HEAD still never buys callstone, needlefall or watchbell: 28/31, the same as verify2, not the 30/31 the claim gives for both sets. Seeds 21-40 give 30/31 (callstone never bought). The 80 % gate still passes.
systems-07 passes for the contract. Profile.emblem does not survive a profile reload, because src/session/profile_store.ts normalizeCurrent drops it. That file is not this lane's, and the lane handed the fix to the client lane correctly.
Sensitivity: this lane produced no image, model or render. It changed copy only in skins (text), so there was nothing to view.
The stitch lead:icons-repoint is scheduled for run 2, after the client lane paints the icons. It is out of scope for this round and not judged here.
